# API Keys

## Viewing & Editing

The recommended way is to use the following:

# install.packages("usethis") # If you don't have it
usethis::edit_r_environ()

Put this code into an R script. Run it and the `.Renviron` file will open in a tab. Then you can edit the contents.

You'll see pairs of values.

`API_NAME="key"`

The key in quotation marks is optional, but recommended.

Important: 
- Make sure there is a blank line at the bottom of the set of APIs.
- No spaces around the = sign.

Save this file when you are done.

Important note: The changes won't work until you restart your R session.

## Accessing the API Keys

Use the `Sys.getenv` function. Here is the format:

`api_key <- Sys.getenv("API_NAME")`
